We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now we're expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Sales Development Representative (Italian) (m/f/d) Your Role

You own our entire Italian-speaking top of funnel: from first contact to qualified demo handoff to our Account Executives. And if you've got what it takes, you'll have a clear path to becoming a closer yourself within a few months.

What to expect

 * Qualify the leads our marketing generates every day

 * Multi-channel outreach: phone, email, LinkedIn, and testing new channels

 * Build sequences: form hypotheses, test, measure, improve

 * Actively shape SDR processes in a fast-growing startup

 * Top-performing SDRs have a real shot at moving into an AE role within months

Who We're Looking For

 * Native-level Italian; good English

 * 1+ years of sales experience, ideally in outbound or telesales, B2B SaaS preferred

 * Naturally competitive, driven to maximize output, and motivated by uncapped commission

What We Offer

 * €45,000-70,000 OTE (base + uncapped commission)

 * Fast-track path to AE

 * Equity: you help build it, you should own a piece of it

 * Equipment of your choice

 * Regular team offsites

Hiring Process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview with our CCO Alex, including a call simulation

 * 30 min chat to get to know the go-to-market manager

 * 20 min culture call with our Founders

How we hire?

We're AI-native, including in hiring. AI helps us to remain efficient, but people make every decision.

fonio is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for talent and ownership, whatever your background is.

Need an adjustment in the process? Just tell us.

Please send your CV in English. Then knock us off our feet ¿

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Financial Accountant (m/f/d) The role

You make sure Fonio's numbers are right and can stand up to auditors and investors. That means owning the monthly and year-end close, and solving tricky questions such as how to account for pay-per-minute revenue across nine markets and more.

As new entities and products launch, you set up the accounting so it scales, rather than patching it later.

What to Expect

 * In-house accounting: Take over accounting from our external provider and build the internal function.

 * Operational ownership: Own day-to-day accounting, including AP/AR, reconciliations, master data and bookkeeping.

 * Monthly close & reporting: Own monthly closing and recurring statutory filings (VAT, ZM, Intrastat, etc.), working closely with our tax advisors.

 * Revenue recognition: make sure usage-based revenue is recognised correctly and consistently.

 * Multi-entity: run intercompany accounting, currencies and consolidation as UK and US entities come online, and integrate acquisitions such as fluently.

 * Controls and policies: write accounting policies and controls that hold up in investor due diligence.

 * Oversight: keep billing, payables and payroll postings accurate, and improve processes and systems as volume grows.

What You Bring

Must-haves

 * 4 to 7 years in accounting, ideally with audit firm training plus time at a tech or SaaS company.

 * Qualified or part-qualified (Bilanzbuchhalter, ACCA, CPA or similar).

 * Has owned month-end and year-end close and statutory accounts under Austrian GAAP (UGB).

 * Confident handling audits and technical accounting questions.

 * Fluent in English.

Nice-to-haves

 * Revenue recognition for subscription or usage-based pricing.

 * Multi-entity consolidation, or IFRS exposure.

 * Experience with post-merger integration or investor due diligence.

 * Familiar with modern finance tools (e.g. BMD, DATEV, Xero or Stripe).

What We Offer

 * €65,000 to €100,000 + Equity

 * Relocation support

 * Daily lunch and dinner

 * Equipment of your choice

 * Regular team off-sites

 * On-site in Vienna, working directly with the core-team

The IT Operational Excellence department drives standardization, optimization and consolidation on strategic level across the RBI Group wherever appropriate.

 

To further support colleagues on their journey of compliant service management within the IT Process Framework we are looking for motivated students (f/m/x) with strong communication and organizational skills that are available to work 20-25h.

our office hours: Mon-Thu 8 am - 5 pm, Fr 8 am - 2 pm

 

Your mission at RBI :

 

 * Learn and work in an agile environment, contributing to the ongoing evolution of the IT-wide IT Process and IT Controls Framework 

 * Assist in ongoing management activities (e.g., status reporting, monitoring, steering and follow-ups) 

 * Collaborate with different internal stakeholders and support their implementation of IT Process and IT Controls Framework
